board_name: Assam Higher Secondary Education Council (Now ASSEB Division-II)

class_11.examination_status: Higher Secondary First Year (+1) Examination under ASSEB guidelines

progression_to_class_12.rule: Promotion to Class 12 requires passing Class 11 examination in chosen stream.

class_12.standard_duration: 3 Hours (9:00 AM to 12:00 PM or 1:30 PM to 4:30 PM)
class_12.passing_criteria: Minimum 30% in each subject (theory + practical) and 30% aggregate.
